profile_text.body:
ClickUp is a for-profit startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Diego, California. The company describes its mission as making the world more productive, and it markets its platform as an all-in-one application for work covering tasks, documents, goals, and chat.

The company's AI product, ClickUp AI, is positioned as an all-in-one productivity tool with capabilities including document generation, task automation, and broad access to workspace data. A feature the site calls Brain² is described as being able to see tasks, documents, and conversations in real time without requiring additional context from the user. ClickUp also has a presence in the MCP server registry through a third-party server that enables management of ClickUp workspaces, including creating, updating, and organizing tasks, lists, folders, and tags.

The held facts note 139 law-related exposure entries associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded. The site itself references internal performance metrics, citing a paid return on ad spend of 4.2x across search, up from 3.8x the prior week, and an activation rate of 38%, described as 4 points higher month-over-month and the highest since December.
